rationale: Builds on the recurrent-tail best family with a compact structural change: add a learned per-tail-block anchor-refresh scalar so reverse recurrence can progressively update its anchor instead of reusing one fixed decoder-output anchor. This targets the locally promising anchor-refresh/mix category, stays compile-stable, adds negligible bytes, and keeps the quant-aware/export path intact.
title: Reverse-Tail Anchor Refresh Gate
